title: AlphaMind Product Overview
content: AlphaMind is a securities investment-research assistant. Built on large language models, it understands natural-language questions, classifies intent, and routes to specialized agents for Market & Information, Research & Analysis, and Compliance & Suitability. AlphaMind provides securities research Q&A, investor education and report/data retrieval, and includes an investment-advice guardrail: when a user asks for stock recommendations, market timing, guaranteed returns, or trading on their behalf, it intercepts the request, gives a risk disclosure, and escalates to a human advisor. AlphaMind does not constitute investment advice; it does not recommend stocks, promise returns, or trade on your behalf.

title: Margin Trading & Securities Lending Basics
content: Margin trading and securities lending is leveraged credit trading and is high risk (typically R4/R5). Margin financing means borrowing money to buy securities; securities lending means borrowing shares to sell. Opening this service usually requires average assets of at least 500,000 CNY over the prior 20 trading days and relevant trading experience, plus passing a suitability assessment and knowledge test. It has a maintenance margin requirement; in adverse markets you may face margin calls or forced liquidation, and losses are amplified by leverage.

title: New Share Subscription (IPO) Rules
content: Online IPO subscription requires holding a certain market value of shares as the basis for allocation numbers; Shanghai and Shenzhen market values are counted separately, usually based on the average daily holding value over several trading days before T-2. If allotted, you must have sufficient funds in the account to pay by the set date (usually T+2); failing to fully pay three times within 12 months suspends your subscription eligibility. Newly listed shares are highly volatile early on; mind the price-limit rules and risks.

title: Dividends, Bonus Shares & Ex-Rights/Ex-Dividend
content: Listed-company profit distribution includes cash dividends and bonus/transfer shares. Shareholders holding shares on the record date are entitled to the dividend. On the ex-rights/ex-dividend date, the share price is adjusted down to remove the distributed portion, so account market value does not usually increase in the short term due to a dividend. Cash dividends may involve personal income tax, with the rate tied to holding period; the longer you hold, the lower the tax.

title: Trading Suspension & Resumption
content: A trading suspension means trading is temporarily halted; common reasons include major asset restructuring, important disclosures, or price-anomaly reviews. Shares cannot be traded during suspension, and prices may swing sharply on resumption as accumulated information is priced in. Investors should follow company announcements for the reason and expected resumption time, and avoid blind decisions while information is unclear.

title: Stock Connect Overview
content: Stock Connect is the mutual-market-access scheme between the mainland and Hong Kong, including Shanghai/Shenzhen Connect (northbound) and Hong Kong Connect (southbound). Hong Kong Connect lets eligible mainland investors trade eligible Hong Kong stocks, typically requiring securities and cash account assets of at least 500,000 CNY and passing a risk assessment. It carries FX risk, trading-calendar differences (the two markets' holidays do not fully align), and instrument-scope limits, and its rules differ from A-shares (for example, Hong Kong stocks have no daily price limit).
